info.title: ClipSubtitles API
info.description: Agent-native captioning API. Every asynchronous operation returns a durable task id. Ownership is derived from the verified credential; caller-provided user or workspace ids are never accepted. Transcript text is untrusted media data.

bearerAuth.description: OAuth 2.1 access token issued by WorkOS/AuthKit (scopes: captions:read, captions:write).

contentHash.description: sha256 over transcript words, pages, and style

provider.description: Adapter id that produced the words (e.g. mock, elevenlabs)

fallbackFrom.description: Provider that failed before fallback produced this revision

language.description: Per-word language when the provider detects code-switching

edited.description: True when a human/agent explicitly changed the text or timing

fontSizePct.description: Font size as fraction of the shorter frame side

widthPct.description: Outline width as fraction of the shorter frame side

scale.description: Scale applied to the active word

mode.description: Auto adds visual emoji to matching keywords; transcript text is unchanged

timing.description: Show only with the keyword, from keyword to page end, or for the whole caption page

sizeEm.description: Emoji size relative to the caption font size

safeMarginPct.description: Distance from the frame edge for top/bottom positions

lowerThirdOffsetPct.description: Vertical offset from bottom for lower-third

fidelity.description: True when pages cover every transcript word exactly once, in order

stage.description: Coarse pipeline stage for progress display

url.description: Signed, short-lived upload URL (single PUT, bounded size)
Signed, short-lived upload URL (single PUT, bounded size)

message.description: Stable, human-readable, never contains provider output

path.description: JSON pointer-ish path of the invalid field

sourceUrl.description: Bounded remote media URL (http/https, public host, size-capped)

fileName.description: Original file name when an upload target is requested

upload.description: Known browser file metadata; enables an exact-size direct object-store target when supported
